# Isolated Quality rendering reference

MIT-licensed rendering subset from the user-supplied qinglong-vr-3d source snapshot.
Copyright and license are retained in LICENSE. SOURCE_HASHES.json records the original
bytes of every included implementation file. Package initializers are replaced with
inert docstrings to avoid application startup; implementation files are unchanged.
Only the relative-depth Quality renderer and its import dependencies are included.
The C++ extension is built separately into ignored `.local/quality-core`, using a
source-hash header generated by our build script. No upstream installer, application,
model loader or video processing entry point is executed. This is a desktop reference,
not code included in the Android APK or the browser bundle.

The tested path is build_relative_quality_geometry → 16-lane visibility →
background proxy / OpenCV Telea → coverage composite. Planner/exemplar dependencies
remain because the original renderer imports them, but are not its active repair path.
